lines_of_business: FEP and SAO follow own guidelines
criteria_location: Position Statement, first page: two bullets plus an experimental sentence. Scoring tables for CHADS2, CHA2DS2-VASc and HAS-BLED follow it as footnotes (*, **, ***).
procedures_covered: Percutaneous LAA closure with FDA-approved device (Watchman, Amplatzer Amulet), CPT 33340
Other devices (Lariat, Amplatzer Cardiac Plug) experimental

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: No exclusion list. Experimental sentence for non-approved devices. No contraindication to anticoagulation required, only a HAS-BLED score.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: increased risk of stroke and/or systemic embolism based on CHADS2 score* ( ≥ 2), or CHA2DS2-VASc score** ( ≥ 3), and systemic anticoagulation therapy is recommended; AND
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Either score qualifies (OR) - a patient can pass on one and fail the other; 'and/or' on stroke/embolism; 'systemic anticoagulation is recommended' is a clinician statement.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: when the all of the following criteria are met
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Typo, but the only all-of marker for two bullets.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: The long-term risks of systemic anticoagulation outweigh the risks of the device implantation (HAS-BLED score*** ≥ 3)
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Parenthesis makes a judgement statement into a score threshold; unclear if HAS-BLED >=3 is the definition or an example.

requirement_kinds.quote: prevention of stroke in individuals with atrial fibrillation
use of a device approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) (eg, the Watchman; Amplatzer Amulet)

thresholds.quote: Alcohol - more than 8 drinks per week

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: One CPT 33340; 'Billing/Coding Information: None applicable' is printed above it.
codes.non_covered_code_lists: None; Lariat and Cardiac Plug named in text only.

external_dependencies.quote: Percutaneous LEFT ATRIAL APPENDAGE Closure (LAAC) (20.34), located at cms.gov.
The use of a device approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA)

resting BP > 140/90 mmHg on at least 2 occasions or current antihypertensive pharmacologic treatment

interesting_structures: Three embedded risk calculators with different definitions of the same condition
Bleeding-risk threshold substitutes for clinical contraindication

fit_to_tree.why: Two-leaf all-of, but each leaf is a computed score whose inputs are chart facts defined differently in three tables, and the OR between two scores hides which one is used.
